name: Acenta Group AB
summary: Acenta Group AB develops a comprehensive sport-technology platform designed to unite and empower the global padel community, from individual players and fans to clubs and businesses. This platform facilitates engagement, competition, and the overall growth of the sport worldwide. Beyond its core technology offering, the company also manages an e-commerce platform that provides padel equipment and apparel to both consumer (B2C) and business (B2B) clients. Established in 2013, Acenta Group AB is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, and operates as a subsidiary of Plan Investor AS.
